title: For the price, it's a major disappointment.
text:
I've subscribed to GQ's Best Stuff Box for years. It only costs $50 and you receive between $250-$400 worth of merchandise each quarter. When I came across the Breo Box, I noticed the price was over THREE TIMES that of the GQ Best Stuff box - but it had all of these wonderful reviews (which now I am thinking are either fake or paid reviews), so I thought I would give it a whirl.

The total RETAIL value of the 7 items in the box equaled $269 and is a real hodgepodge of items. This is what was included in the Summer 2020 box:

(1) Clean Key
(2) A disposable device that is supposed to help you stop snoring
(3) A mini projector
(4) Outdoor Picnic Blanket
(5) A very tiny massage roller
(6) A fitness band
(7) A in-car cradle and charger for your smartphone

The box was a bunch of junk that I totally paid TOO MUCH money on!! I will NEVER order from Breo Box again.
label: negative
